result.summary: Do not ship: removing the cap regresses progress and completion displays for extracted files.

findings.title: Restore the 100% cap for files larger locally than remotely
findings.body: For local_size=20 and remote_size=10, this now produces 200 instead of 100. These exact inputs are covered by the existing percent-downloaded test, which expects 100. transfer-row.component.html renders the uncapped percentage at line 28 and requires exactly 100 for success styling and the “Done” label at lines 33 and 53. Extracted files therefore show inflated progress and lose completion indicators. The template's width clamp at line 35 only protects the bar width; it does not protect these other consumers.
findings.recommendation: Restore Math.min(100, ...) around the calculated percentage and run the existing ViewFile percent-downloaded test, including its local-size-greater-than-remote vectors.

next_steps: Restore the cap and verify the existing regression test passes.
